args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

After splitting on \n, only one trailing empty line (from a single final newline) is popped; a statement with a blank line after the last transaction leaves an extra empty string in `lines`, which is parsed as a one-field row and fails assertShape. The loop (or the line-splitting step) should skip/ignore blank trailing or interior empty lines instead of treating them as data rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
parseStatement does `if (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1] === "") lines.pop();` only once, then loops over all remaining lines calling assertShape on each including blank ones, which throws `errors.rowShape` ("Malformed row...") exactly as described, at the row past the last transaction.
